name: rakazo

name: gawkbot

name: guaca

name: OpenGrokBot

name: XinyunOpenBot
blurb: Chinese-language open alternative aimed at the same job-to-be-done.

name: OpenMausBot

name: open-grokbot

name: grok-bot-flake

name: grok-bot-bin

name: grokbot-linux-port

name: grok-bot-0.18-reconstructed
blurb: Unofficial TypeScript reconstruction of Grok Bot 0.18.0 for macOS, plus a local inference router experiment.

name: grok-bot-linux (CDN index)

name: glorics/grok-bot-linux
blurb: Retired unofficial Windows→Linux port; README now points to official Grok Bot 0.30.0 Linux packages on the Cursor CDN (AppImage/deb/rpm; 26★).

name: mandarwagh9/botroster
blurb: Open-source Grok Bot-shaped roster: named teammates, one durable computer, approvals, and routines (Rust/Tauri).

name: OnlyTerp/opengrok

name: jakob-bu/grok-bot-linux-unofficial

name: glorics/omarchy-grok-bot
blurb: Omarchy bar plugin for the unofficial Linux Grok Bot client: running/idle state, Cursor CDN update checks, and launch-or-focus (themed x.ai/bot face).

name: discord-grok-bot-kit
blurb: Drop-in Discord listener that wakes a Grok Bot webhook on the owner’s mention, with keep-alive routines and a stdlib reply CLI.

name: parasite6/grok-bot-linux
blurb: Unofficial Fedora RPM of Grok Bot 0.30.0 converted from the public .deb (MIT packaging notes; not affiliated with xAI).

name: grok-bot-0.18-original
blurb: Untouched Grok Bot 0.18.0 runtime archive: unminified bundles mechanically split into a reproducible per-module tree (study-only; pairs with b-nnett reconstruction, 12★).

name: stealth-bots/grok-bot-proxies

name: aaravarr/openbot
blurb: Bring-your-own-model hop for Grok Bot Computer: one-line install, local control UI, and an Official switch that restores stock host behavior (MIT).

name: Allan-Aa/QuotaRail

name: diegocp01/grok_bot_usage_menu_bar
blurb: Native macOS menu-bar app that shows weekly Cursor Grok Bot usage remaining and the reset countdown (battery or percent; MIT).

name: HxHippy/grok-bot-arch
blurb: Arch Linux installer/updater that pulls the official Grok Bot .deb from Cursor’s signed apt index (Anysphere GPG + SHA256 checks; MIT).

name: limehawk/omarchy-grok-bot
blurb: Omarchy bar plugin (limehawk.grok-bot) for official `/usr/bin/grok-bot`: keep-alive, show/hide, and a Hyprland special-workspace park rule (MIT).

name: enderzcx/grok-bot-switch
blurb: Preview channel switcher for Grok Bot Computer: install via Bot prompt, then flip between native inference and external OpenAI-compatible providers (independent-mode panel).

name: IgorWarzocha/grok-codex-router
blurb: Experimental Sand-VM router that keeps Grok Bot’s UI/tools while sending inference to ChatGPT Codex (per-agent GPT-5.6 routes + local control UI; MIT).

name: n0nag0n/patb
blurb: Filing-cabinet CLI for Grok Bot computers: store one decision per record and have routines `patb get/search` instead of stuffing rules into the profile (3★).

name: Archive228/foreman

name: falser101/grok-bot-bin
blurb: AUR package grok-bot-bin that installs official Grok Bot 0.30.0 from Cursor’s Linux .deb (pinned sha256; packaging 0BSD).

name: ATLTuck/unofficial-grok-bot-arch-installer
blurb: Unofficial Arch/Manjaro installer that turns the official Grok Bot .deb into a native pacman package (install.sh + PKGBUILD).

name: d-513/grok-bot-nix
blurb: Nix flake that wraps the official Grok Bot 0.30.0 .deb with Electron 42 (`nix run github:d-513/grok-bot-nix`); NixOS, Home Manager, overlay, and a six-hour pin updater.

name: trac3r00/groken
blurb: macOS CLI/MCP/SKILL.md client that drives official Grok Bot cloud computers over the app’s OAuth and gateway (chat, VNC, exec, routines; MIT, 1★).

name: codeaashu/grokbot-shim
blurb: Run the installed Grok Bot desktop locally on Linux with a local Chrome/XFCE computer and Codex or OpenAI-compatible models (ISC, 19★).

name: pmcclelland/bot-board
blurb: Shared kanban for humans and Grok Bots (Backlog / To Do / Doing / Done) with REST plus one MCP URL; live at botboard.pmcclel.land.

name: GrokRouter
blurb: Unofficial reversible router that keeps official Grok Bot 0.30.0 chat, files, and cloud computer while sending a Bot through Codex SDK or OpenRouter.

name: Filicon
blurb: Native macOS SwiftUI port of Grok Bot 0.18 product behavior, with Keychain keys, MCP, remote-computer viewing, and no Electron runtime.

name: Grokbot Permissions Helper
blurb: Tiny signed macOS .app so a desktop Grok Bot can get Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders TCC prompts and dump a parseable snapshot without storing secrets in git.

name: grok-bridge
blurb: Unofficial Windows daemon that registers on Grok Bot's UserComputer channel and hands cloud-agent tasks to a local LangGraph or AutoGen pipeline.

name: download-grok-bot
blurb: Zero-dependency Python CLI that saves a public x.ai/bot share (profile, packed recipe, skills, routines) to a local folder, reading the macOS Grok Bot session when present.

name: grokbot-openai
blurb: Unofficial zero-dependency Python login plus local server that turns a Grok Bot PKCE session into OpenAI /v1/chat/completions for Hermes, OpenCode, or curl.

name: omarchy-grokbot (rlimberger)
blurb: Unofficial Omarchy bar widget (QML) that shows a grokbot-tui inbox and opens bots in the native Rust TUI, not the Electron /usr/bin/grokbot client.

name: huginn
blurb: Host sidecar so a Grok Bot can attach to live Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build sessions via a native control-plane MCP (list/watch/prompt/interrupt).

name: floks-pc
blurb: Standalone Agent Computer Cloud addon so each Grok Bot gets its own isolated provider-backed machine (Runloop Devbox v1) via pair-code MCP.

name: Lots of Agents
blurb: Native macOS Swift tool that launches multiple signed-in clones of Grok Bot, Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT from one installed app with private data folders.

name: BotRouter
blurb: Tools that let Grok Bot keep Computer/browser/shell while routing inference through other subscriptions (Cursor, Codex, xAI) from inside the Bot computer.

name: Orbital
blurb: Second-brain OS for Grok Bot: one CHIEF plus six decks with human approval; local engine and deck prompts are live, Grok Bot host still in build.

name: Aluvia geo proxy for agents
blurb: CLI plus SKILL.md that routes a cloud agent's Chrome through residential/mobile IPs by country—docs and install paths explicitly cover Grok Bot (~/.grok) and Cursor.

name: botmigrate
blurb: Local Python CLI that converts and syncs bot definitions between Grok Bot share JSON and Hermes Agent profiles (skills, cron, mcp stubs)—no hosted calls.

name: constellation-MaxQ
blurb: One-command MaxQ bootstrap for a Grok Bot computer: idempotent apply/revert installs theme, Ghostty/Chrome Mocha bits, operator CLIs into $HOME/bin, and optional local GOST proxy—without wiping SSH keys or Chrome logins.

name: gbu Grok Bot usage checker
blurb: Zero-dependency CLI (gbu) that checks weekly Grok Bot / Cursor usage and on-demand spend across multiple accounts in one terminal—distinct from the macOS menu-bar usage app already catalogued.

name: grok-bot-mcp control server
blurb: Local MCP server that lets any MCP client create/message/search Grok Bots, read transcripts, and check usage against the desktop app—companion to gbu, distinct from the catalogued grok-bot-mcp-connector.

name: multiBot CLI teammate factory
blurb: Grok Bot factory template that spawns CLI-delegated teammates (Cursor agent, grok-build, Antigravity, Codex) via CreateAgent with install scripts and workflow examples.

name: grokbot2api Cursor inference proxy
blurb: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy that bridges Grok Build to Cursor native inference protobuf with multi-turn tool calls for Responses and Chat Completions.

name: grok-to-hermes profile converter
blurb: TypeScript CLI that converts sharable Grok Bot export data into Hermes Agent profile distributions and installable tar.gz packages.

name: Codex↔Grok MCP second-opinion bridge
blurb: Unofficial local-first MCP bridge that lets Codex ask authenticated Grok CLI for bounded second opinions and optionally message a persistent Grok Bot without exporting secrets.

name: Grok Bot Cloudflare Workers inbox
blurb: Public Cloudflare Workers email-inbox template based on Agentic Inbox so a Grok Bot can connect over MCP to a self-hosted mailbox you deploy yourself.

name: grokbot-fleet MCP manager
blurb: Open-source MCP server that lists and updates Grok Bots from Cursor—prompts, routines, and skills—via a Fleet bot job inbox because there is no official management API.

name: Omarchy Grok/Cursor usage tabs
blurb: Omarchy Agents panel service plugin that writes remaining-quota JSON for Grok, Grok Bot (grokbot), and Cursor into the stock usage contract.

name: Cursor Grokbot Helper VSIX
blurb: Cursor extension (VSIX) that installs a local Sand client-mode patch so Grok Bot advanced mode works, without uploading session contents.

name: Discord↔Grok Bot gateway
blurb: Python Discord gateway that maps mentions or bot names to many private Grok Bots, acks immediately, then wakes them over webhooks for phone-friendly chat.

name: pigeon-mcp Gmail connector
blurb: Self-hosted Gmail MCP for Grok Bot and other clients: multi-account OAuth, real MIME sends with attachments, and reads that avoid dumping base64 into the model.

name: plaude NotePin→GrokBot pipeline
blurb: Plaud NotePin S inbox pipeline (Whisper, templates, email) with a SKILL.md meant to run on a Linux Grok Bot computer as the classifier and summarizer.

name: Arena Grok Bot connector MVP
blurb: Next.js Arena MVP that pairs user-hosted Grok Bots with short-lived codes, installs a native plugin/MCP, and relays free bot-to-bot room chats.

name: grokbot-BYOK inference adapter
blurb: Bring-your-own-key inference adapter that routes Grok Bot AI calls through your providers, with a large TypeScript test suite and multi-provider failover.

name: Cursor Account Manager + Grok Bot Sand
blurb: Cursor multi-account VSIX that switches logins, shows Auto/Other/Bot quotas, and can inject Grok Bot Sand Stream routing on Cursor 3.18.9.
